description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and macros for CUDA JIT compilation within the ATen library, including kernel descriptor creation, vectorization checks, code generation, and type name mappings.

classes.name: NvrtcFunction
classes.description: Holds CUDA module and function handles for JIT compiled kernels.

classes.name: KernelDescriptor
classes.description: Describes a CUDA kernel including its name, function, input/output types, and number of inputs/outputs.

classes.name: delayed_false
classes.description: Template struct used to delay static_assert failure for invalid types.

methods.name: get_extra_args_types
methods.description: Returns a vector of ScalarType corresponding to the argument types.

methods.name: make_kernel_descriptor
methods.description: Creates a KernelDescriptor with specified parameters.

methods.name: can_vectorize_up_to
methods.description: Determines the maximum vectorization size based on pointer alignment.

methods.name: generate_code
methods.description: Generates CUDA kernel code based on kernel descriptor and parameters.

methods.name: jit_pwise_function
methods.description: Compiles a CUDA kernel from code string and kernel name.

methods.name: launch_jitted_pwise_function
methods.description: Launches a JIT-compiled CUDA kernel with provided arguments and configuration.

methods.name: initializeCudaContext
methods.description: Initializes the CUDA context for JIT compilation.
